<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Related to #20510 — group 11 only.

Makes process command resource attributes default-off independently of `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview`. Explicit opt-ins and opt-outs remain supported. Java agent thread details were split out and their defaults are unchanged by this PR.

- **Defaults:** Gate process command attributes solely on their dedicated setting. Preserve other process attributes.
- **Coverage:** Test absent, enabled, and disabled flat settings; consolidate obsolete process preview cases.
- **Documentation:** Update resource usage, metadata, and breaking-change migration notes.

To retain capture:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.resources.experimental.process-command-attributes.enabled=true
```

No unrelated selectors, instrumentation names, or shared preview helpers change.
proposal.title: Make process command attributes and agent thread details opt-in for 3.0

### 🟡 Changes recommended The advertised thread-details default change is absent, leaving half of the stated behavior unimplemented.
1 open finding - [Thread details remain enabled outside v3 preview](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20511#discussion_r4260952223) · New
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

[Javaagent] The title and description also promise that `otel.javaagent.add-thread-details` becomes default-off independently of v3 preview, but the production path still defaults it with `!v3Preview` in `AgentDistributionConfig.java:237`; without preview, thread details therefore remain enabled. Please either implement that default change with its flat-config coverage and migration note, or remove thread details from this PR's stated scope.
